questions.question: The income of A is 25% more than that of B and the income of C is 65% less than the sum of the incomes of A and B. Income of C is what percent less than the income of A?
questions.questionHtml: The income of A is 25% more than that of B and the income of C is 65% less than the sum of the incomes of A and B. Income of C is what percent less than the income of A?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Let Income of B = 100.

Then Income of A = 125 and Income of C = (125 + 100) × 0.35 = 78.75.

Difference between A and C = 125 − 78.75 = 46.25.

Required % = (46.25 ÷ 125) × 100 = 37%.

∴ The correct answer is 37%.

Alternate Method

Given:

Income of A is 25% more than B.

Income of C is 65% less than (A + B).

Calculations:

⇒ Let Income of B = 100 units

⇒ Income of A = 100 + 25% of 100 = 125 units

⇒ Sum of A and B = 125 + 100 = 225 units

⇒ Income of C = 225 − 65% of 225 = 35% of 225

⇒ Income of C = 0.35 × 225 = 78.75 units

⇒ Difference between A and C = 125 − 78.75 = 46.25 units

⇒ Percentage less = (Difference ÷ Income of A) × 100

⇒ Percentage less = (46.25 ÷ 125) × 100 = 37%

∴ The correct answer is 37%.

Additional Information

Percentage Comparison Formula

To find how much % X is less than Y, use: [(Y − X) ÷ Y] × 100.

Base Value Selection

Always identify the than part in the question to determine the denominator (base) for percentage calculation.

Successive Percentage

For two successive changes a% and b%, the effective change is [a + b + (ab ÷ 100)]%.

questions.question: If x is added to each of 12, 28, 21 and 45, the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 3) and (4x + 1)?
questions.questionHtml: If x is added to each of 12, 28, 21 and 45, the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 3) and (4x + 1)?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

For numbers a, b, c, d in proportion after adding x, use the formula:

x = (ad − bc) ÷ (a + d − b − c)

⇒ x = (12 × 45 − 28 × 21) ÷ (12 + 45 − 28 − 21)

⇒ x = (540 − 588) ÷ (57 − 49) = −48 ÷ 8 = −6 (Taking magnitude, x = 6)

Mean Proportional = √((6 + 3) × (4 × 6 + 1)) = √(9 × 25) = 3 × 5 = 15.

∴ The correct answer is 15.

Alternate Method

Given: Numbers are 12, 28, 21, 45. x is added to each.

Formula Used: If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a/b = c/d. Mean proportional of p and q is √(p × q).

⇒ (12 + x) ÷ (28 + x) = (21 + x) ÷ (45 + x)

⇒ (12 + x)(45 + x) = (21 + x)(28 + x)

⇒ 540 + 12x + 45x + x2 = 588 + 21x + 28x + x2

⇒ 540 + 57x = 588 + 49x

⇒ 57x − 49x = 588 − 540

⇒ 8x = 48 ⇒ x = 6

⇒ First term = x + 3 = 6 + 3 = 9

⇒ Second term = 4x + 1 = 4 × 6 + 1 = 25

⇒ Mean Proportional = √(9 × 25) = √225 = 15

∴ The correct answer is 15.

Additional Information

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is defined as √(ab).

Third Proportional

If a, b, c are in continued proportion, then c = b2/a is the third proportional.

Fourth Proportional

If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then d = (b × c) / a is the fourth proportional.

It should be replaced with “I will purchase”. This is in the simple future tense.

Use the simple future to talk about an action or condition that will begin and end in the future.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
questions.solution:
The word to be used in the blank is “largest”.

The superlative(the third or highest degree of comparison in adjectives or adverbs) of “large”, which is “largest” has to be used here since the word preceding the blank is “world’s”. This indicates that when considering all the water bodies on this earth, the Pacific Ocean covers a vast area. 

“Larger” is a comparative(the second or middle degree of comparison in adjectives or adverbs).

The comparative and superlative degrees are formed by adding the -er and -est suffix to adjectives and adverbs with a single consonant for an ending.

Comparative adjectives are used to compare differences between the two objects they modify (larger, smaller, faster, higher). They are used in sentences where two nouns are compared, in this pattern:

Noun (subject) + verb + comparative adjective + than + noun (object).

Superlative adjectives are used to describe an object which is at the upper or lower limit of a quality (the tallest, the smallest, the fastest, the highest). They are used in sentences where a subject is compared to a group of objects.

Noun (subject) + verb + the + superlative adjective + noun (object).

“Large” means “of considerable or relatively great size, extent, or capacity” and “more large” is grammatically incorrect, both these options are cancelled.

Hence the correct answer is option 1.

questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. And 844 million don’t have access to clean water close to home, according to the latest report by WaterAid.
B. Around 4 billion people in the world live in physically water-scarce areas.
C. It is because globally we use six times as much water today as we did 100 years ago.
D. The world’s water crisis is getting worse.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4: BADC

We can gather from the above sentences that the paragraph is about the global water crisis. 

Sentence B comes 1st as a paragraph always starts with a general statement and B serves as the introductory sentence of the para which introduces us to the topic. 

Sentence A comes 2nd as it sheds more light on the issue mentioned in sentence B.

Sentence D follows A as it gives us a gist of the topic mentioned in sentences B and A.

Sentence C follows B as it provides a reason for the water crisis getting worse- an issue mentioned in sentence D.

Hence the correct order is BADC.
